package.name: threevn_control
package.description:
The 3VN robot abstraction and its scenario library.
RobotClient wraps the ROS 2 interface (topic for state, action for motion) behind a small Python API, and the scenarios are written against that API alone.
ARCHITECTURAL RULE: like threevn_bringup, this package must never depend on Gazebo. Its whole value is that a scenario written once runs unchanged against mock, against Gazebo and against the physical arm. A simulator dependency here would quietly destroy that.
